topics: Saleor's recipe models vendors using custom models; vendor is not a built-in Saleor entity.
Commodity-marketplace and boutique-marketplace approaches have different product/offer modeling implications.
Vendor resource ownership must be enforced by application-level authorization; identity tokens alone do not provide object-level isolation.
Order-line vendor association can inform independent vendor fulfillment and shipping analysis.
Customer payments and vendor payouts are separate concerns; the recipe describes asynchronous payouts after successful payment.
Tax calculation may require vendor-specific rules.

workstreamPrompts.A1: Test seller/tenant ownership isolation on every relevant mutation and read path.
workstreamPrompts.A3: Review the chosen product/offer, pricing, commission and vendor-specific tax semantics against approved platform contracts.
workstreamPrompts.A4: Test mixed-vendor orders, immutable line-to-vendor ownership, split fulfillment, refund/recovery, payout idempotency and reconciliation where these capabilities are in approved scope.
workstreamPrompts.A5: Use app/webhook details only for actual approved provider-integration boundaries.
workstreamPrompts.A7: Ensure seller/operator administration journeys respect separate role and ownership scopes.

exclusions: Do not import Saleor Model/Attribute as a mandatory platform data model.
Do not assume Stripe Connect or any provider recommendation is the platform payment decision.
Do not create a Saleor runtime, Dashboard vendor portal, or second source of truth.

consumptionProtocol: Discover the relevant page/rule through llms.txt or Documentation MCP.
Pin its source repository, commit, path, symbol and relevant upstream test.
Verify intended Saleor behavior in pinned Saleor 3.23.43 source/tests and Dashboard 3.23.39 where relevant.
Map the behavior to the existing platform domain owner and approved SPI/ADR.
Prove the platform behavior with JUnit, integration/security and Dashboard E2E tests; log divergences instead of silently adopting them.
